meta.name: genomic-intelligence
meta.description: Predict regulatory features, gene structure, and expression directly from DNA sequence using Genomic Intelligence's hosted transformer DNA language models — no local GPU or model weights. Six tasks over a REST API and a hosted MCP server (keyless public demo): promoter regions, splice donor/acceptor sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, sequence-to-expression (log TPM), and de-novo gene annotation, plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow. Use when the user has a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a DNA/FASTA sequence and wants any of these predictions, mentions Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, api.genomicintelligence.ai, or mcp.genomicintelligence.ai.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入基因名或一段 DNA 序列,直接预测启动子、剪接位点、增强子活性和表达量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有基因符号或 DNA 序列,想快速拿到调控与表达层面的预测结果
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a gene symbol or DNA sequence and want quick regulatory and expression predictions

howto.what: Claude 会把基因名、基因组区间或 DNA/FASTA 序列发给 Genomic Intelligence 的云端模型,返回启动子、剪接位点、增强子活性、染色质状态、表达量(log TPM)和基因注释等预测,本机不需要 GPU 或模型权重。
howto.when: 当你手上有基因符号、基因组区间或 DNA/FASTA 序列,想得到启动子、表达量等预测,或提到 Genomic Intelligence、genomicintelligence.ai 等名称时触发。

say.text: 帮我找出 TP53 这段区域里的启动子位置
say.note: 返回启动子区间的预测结果

say.text: 用 K562 细胞预测这段序列的表达量(log TPM)
say.note: expression 任务必须给出细胞类型描述

say.text: 从这段基因组区间里找出基因,并预测每个基因的表达量
say.note: 走「先找基因再预测表达」的组合流程

howto.what_en: Claude sends a gene symbol, region, or DNA/FASTA sequence to Genomic Intelligence's hosted DNA models and returns regulatory, expression, and gene-annotation predictions. No local GPU or weights needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you have a gene symbol, genomic region, or DNA/FASTA sequence and want such predictions, or when you mention Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, etc.

say_en.text: Find the promoter regions in the TP53 locus
Predict expression (log TPM) for this sequence in K562 cells
Find the genes in this region and predict each one's expression
